quotient_rule: Build the high-pivot pair-sum row basis; backsolve its 124-dimensional right nullspace. For each subgroup-control feature row, form the 124-bit vector of parity evaluations against the nullspace basis. The rank of those vectors is exactly the increase in row rank after adjoining all subgroup controls. Also compute subgroup-control rank directly.
claim_boundary: Finite-sample comparison of quadratic feature row spaces for the exact pair sums and 8192 independently doubled subgroup points.
